Find epithelial structures for review

Source: R/structures.R
gk_structures.Rd

Runs deterministic centroid-based DBSCAN on cells awaiting a configured structure decision. Epsilon is the 95th percentile of the (min_pts - 1)th nearest-neighbour distance, bounded by eps_min and eps_max. Retained structures are ordered by decreasing size and then centroid coordinates, making IDs stable under input row permutation.

Usage

gk_structures(
  classification,
  prepared,
  eps_min = 15,
  eps_max = 30,
  min_pts = 10L,
  min_cells = 20L
)

Arguments

classification

A gk_classify() result.

prepared

The matching gk_prepare() result.

eps_min, eps_max

Lower and upper bounds for DBSCAN epsilon in the coordinate units of the cellspec.

min_pts

DBSCAN minimum points.

min_cells

Minimum cells for an exported structure.

Value

An object of class gk_structures with structures, cell_structure, parameters and provenance hashes.

See also

Other classification: gk_classify(), gk_state_calls()

Examples

prep <- gk_prepare(gk_example_path("example-slide"), gk_example_config(), quiet = TRUE)
th <- gk_thresholds(prep, gk_example_config(), seed = 1L)
cl <- gk_classify(prep, th, gk_example_config())
#> Warning: 1 hierarchy rule disabled because required markers are not callable.
if (requireNamespace("dbscan", quietly = TRUE)) gk_structures(cl, prep)
